0022600106.text: The 76ers (2-0, W2 streak) host the Milwaukee Bucks (0-1, L1 streak) in Philadelphia's third game of the season, with the 76ers first in the Atlantic and the East and the Bucks 13th in the East and 4th in the Central, 1 game back. Philadelphia swept the four-game 2025-26 season series, most recently beating Milwaukee 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season. Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain) are out for the 76ers, while Dean Wade is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision.
